sections.title: Look Back (Review)
paragraphs: Pray for one another: Thanksgiving and Requests
Sing a song of praise together
Review & Accountability
To whom did you tell Jesus’ story?
Have someone teach the “Hand Gospel”
What was the topic of the last lesson? What did you learn?
(Abiding in Christ)

sections.title: Look Up (New Teaching)
paragraphs: Read
God shows us His love every day. We should imitate Him and show His love to everyone around us. It is because of His love for us that we desire to make His name known among all people and places.
Matthew 22:34-40
Luke 10:25-37 (The Good Samaritan)
Tell It as a Story
Can someone tell this story in their own words?
Practice in groups of two.
Teach
God commands us to love Him with all our heart, soul, mind, and strength.
God commands us to love our neighbors as we love ourselves.
During this time, Samaritans and Jews hated each other.
We should be like the Good Samaritan.
We should show love to all people no matter their position.
Ask
What did you learn from these Scriptures?
Think a little, how will you practice what you have learned?

sections.title: Look Forward (Obedience)
paragraphs: Make a Plan
Think of a person or family in your community that you or many people do not like and commit to show them the love of Christ this week.
Continue sharing the gospel with your family and friends!
To whom will you tell Jesus’ story?
Vision Casting
God desires for every person in the world to repent of their sins. Let’s commit to preach the Gospel among all people.
2 Peter 3:9
Pray
Ask God to help us to show the love of Christ to all the people around us. May we love Him with all our heart, mind, soul and strength.
